headline:
إيرادات محتوى Xbox
تتراجع 2%
label: أرقام
note: Microsoft FY27 Q1 release (28 Oct 2026, investor site and SEC 8-K Ex. 99.1): 'XBOX content and services revenue decreased 2% (down 1% in constant currency)'; product table XBOX $5,379M vs $5,508M. No hardware figure in Microsoft's documents (the -14% in outlets is not used). Stand-in footage: Fable official release-date trailer (Xbox Games Showcase 2026, IGN 3840 copy, decode clean), credited «لقطات من Fable». Our bed: the trailer's dialogue runs nearly throughout and has nothing to do with the results (only music-led stretch 142.1 to 152.6 s, too short); no blood or fire shots (avoided 73-76, 120-127, 167-169).
